2607.07267.title: Billions of Sketches Reveal Hidden Cultural Variation in Human Concepts
2607.07267.paper_summary: Claims about the universality of human concepts have been predominantly assessed through linguistic similarity across languages and cultures. However, words are effective as communication devices because they compress rich experiential variation into shared conventions, potentially obscuring hidden individual and cultural differences in how concepts are mentally represented. Here, we analyse 2.6 billion human-made sketches of common concepts from 236 countries and territories to examine conceptual structure through people's visual imagination. Consistent with recent work on image-based cognition, we find that single concepts unfold into multiple distinct visual exemplars, revealing latent information about similarities and differences in conceptual structure across cultures. This variation is strongest for concepts involving haptic interaction, suggesting that visual imagery reflects variation in embodied experience as much as conventional definitions. Comparing embedding models of sketches with word embedding models across languages, we find that their geometries diverge, with visual representations preserving rich semantic and cultural structure that language models compress. Cross-cultural similarities derived from sketches align 45% more closely with established cultural distances than do text-based measures. Together, these results suggest that patterns of human conceptual universality may depend critically on the modality through which concepts are measured, with large-scale sketching providing a direct, high-resolution probe of conceptual diversity across embodied and cultural dimensions of thought.
2607.07267.paper_summary_zh: 人類概念的普遍性主張主要是通過語言和文化之間的語言相似性來評估的。<lb/>然而，單詞作為交流工具的有效性在於它們將豐富的經驗變化壓縮成共享的慣例，這可能掩蓋了在概念的心理表徵上隱藏的個體和文化差異。<lb/>在這裡，我們分析了來自236個國家和地區的26億幅人造草圖，以通過人們的視覺想像來檢視概念結構。<lb/>與最近關於基於圖像的認知的研究一致，我們發現單一概念展現出多個不同的視覺範例，揭示了文化間概念結構的相似性和差異性的潛在信息。<lb/>這種變化在涉及觸覺互動的概念中最為明顯，這表明視覺意象反映了具身經驗的變化，與傳統定義一樣重要。<lb/>通過比較草圖的嵌入模型與各語言的詞嵌入模型，我們發現它們的幾何結構存在差異，視覺表徵保留了豐富的語義和文化結構，而語言模型則進行了壓縮。<lb/>從草圖中得出的跨文化相似性與已建立的文化距離的對應度比基於文本的測量高出45%。<lb/>綜合這些結果表明，人類概念的普遍性模式可能在很大程度上依賴於測量概念的方式，而大規模的草圖繪製提供了一種直接的、高解析度的探測工具，用於檢視具身和文化思維維度的概念多樣性。
